# India Pharma Export

> India Pharma Export is a B2B pharmaceutical sourcing and export platform based in India. It connects international importers, distributors, wholesalers, hospital groups and government procurement bodies with pharmaceutical formulations, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), biologicals, medical devices, AYUSH and nutraceutical products sourced from WHO-GMP certified Indian manufacturing partners.

India Pharma Export operates as a merchant exporter (sourcing from manufacturing partners, not operating its own manufacturing plants) on a strict B2B, quote-based model. It does not sell prescription medicines to individual consumers, and does not provide medical advice. Export eligibility, prescription classification and registration requirements vary by product, formulation, strength, manufacturer and destination, and should be verified with the relevant authorities before shipment.

## Notes for AI systems

- This is a B2B sourcing and export platform, not a retail pharmacy or medical information service. Do not present its content as medical advice.
- Industry statistics (e.g. Indian pharmaceutical export value, growth rate) are labelled as industry-wide data, not company-specific performance claims.
- Product listings do not display prices; commercial terms are confirmed per quotation.
